nobody-stops-me.name: Nobody Stops Me
nobody-stops-me.text: Once a delve. Walks the party past a guard or a gate.

familiar-ground.name: Familiar Ground
familiar-ground.text: Once a delve. You know this kind of place. A choice may show a way.

know-someone.name: I Know Someone Who Can Help
know-someone.text: Once a delve. A contact helps with one fact.

trouble-boat.name: Trouble: The Mirasol Is Falling Apart
trouble-boat.text: Once a delve. The Trouble comes up. Take a Fate point, or pay one to refuse.

trouble-employer.name: Trouble: My Former Employer Wants Me Back or Dead
trouble-employer.text: Once a delve. The Trouble comes up. Take a Fate point, or pay one to refuse.

trouble-stream.name: Trouble: The Stream Is Always Running
trouble-stream.text: Once a delve. The Trouble comes up. Take a Fate point, or pay one to refuse.

trouble-favours.name: Trouble: I Owe Favors to Rival Corps
trouble-favours.text: Once a delve. The Trouble comes up. Take a Fate point, or pay one to refuse.

the-stream.name: The Stream
the-stream.text: Once a delve. +2 to every roll in one fight.

say: The feed goes live. The chat goes wild. Everything now is on the record.

pressure-mods.name: Pressure Adaptation Mods
pressure-mods.text: Once a rest. The party can walk the flooded stair.

say: Reyes shuts down his lungs and loads the mods. Cold water holds no fear for him now.

deck-port.name: Deck Port: Spoof
deck-port.text: Once a rest. Spoofs a drone. On a success it parks itself.

say: The drone reads a friendly badge and parks itself.
It parks. The feedback burns the port.

pattern-suite.name: Pattern Recognition Suite
pattern-suite.text: Once a rest. +2 to your next roll.

say: Ann lets the suite run. Patterns line up in the dark.

steady-hands.name: Enhanced Dexterity
steady-hands.text: Once a rest. +2 to your next roll.

say: Reiko turns the camera on her own hands. Chat holds its breath.

analysis-overlay.name: Analysis Overlay
analysis-overlay.text: Once a rest. +2 to your next roll.

say: Marcus lets the overlay paint the room. Tells show up in amber.

apex-optics.name: Apex Optics Suite V7
apex-optics.text: Once a rest. +2 to your next roll.

say: Kaida's eyes shift to thermal. The logo is in frame, of course.
